answers.question: check whether the growth is organic and repeatable
answers.answer: Revenue has risen sharply (₹1,209.79 m to ₹5,169.49 m) [business, page 283], but EBITDA margins fell from 23.6% to 16.4% and operating cash flow turned negative, while receivable days jumped, suggesting the growth is driven by credit sales rather than organic operational efficiency. No explicit discussion of the drivers is found in the prospectus.
